$comment: The tier map for tools/sync: ordered rules over upstream repo-relative paths, first match wins.
Each rule has "path" (exact) or "glob" ("*" within a segment, "**" any number of segments) and a tier:
1 vendored verbatim apart from the repo-wide glob rules (the namespace rename); 2 vendored with listed transforms.json rules; 3 rewritten for Avalonia and watched (the report lists PRs touching it);
"none" not imported. A rule that matches no file fails the sync. Seeded from spikes/A-engine/outcomes.json and the Spike A and D reports.
